about.title: About Me
about.content: I am a passionate software developer from Bolivia with a track record of steady growth, from intern to consultant. I focus on building robust, scalable, and efficient web applications, with a special emphasis on code quality and architecture.
about.history: My journey began with curiosity about how the web worked, which led me to quickly professionalize in the JavaScript and PHP/Python ecosystem. I've worked on projects ranging from rapid MVPs to large-scale refactoring of enterprise systems.
